# grout13

Public Git/CDN module for compact JS13k-style atlas payloads.

Browser global:
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Shoozes/grout13@main/dist/grout13.global.min.js`

Browser ESM:
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Shoozes/grout13@main/dist/grout13.mjs`

The reviewed facade exports the Grout13 v1 compiler, decoder, generated
runtime-source helpers, and payload byte counter. Use the public Git artifact
for preview/tiny-game delivery; npm is intentionally not the release path for
this repository.
